atoms.word: p y r a m i d

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Pyramids were built to bury dead pharaohs in them. The shape of pyramids had a special reason: the top pointed towards the sky so that the souls of the pharaohs could rise up to the afterlife.

The construction of a large pyramid took around 20 years and employed thousands of people. Each pyramid needed more than 6 million tonnes of rock. As it took so long, the construction of a pyramid began as soon as the new pharaoh was crowned.
The largest pyramid was built for the Pharaoh Khufu. It was built in around 2600 BC, along with two other large pyramids, near the city of Giza and is 146 metres high.

atoms.a: What was a pyramid used for?
b: as a school for children of civil servants
as a museum for Egyptian art

atoms.a: Approximately how long did it take to build a large pyramid?
Who is the largest of the three pyramids of Giza named after?

atoms.b: The pyramids weren’t the only ((++religious rebellious)) monuments the Egyptians built.
Many temples were also built to honour the ((++gods Greeks)).
Only pharaohs and priests were allowed into the ((++temples teepees)) because they were believed to be holy.

feedback.finish: Temples started becoming more popular than pyramids in the Middle Kingdom because pyramids were often robbed. By the New Kingdom, almost all pharaohs were buried in the Valley of Kings instead.
